players.product: AvalonMiner bitcoin mining machines (A15 / A16 series; Avalon A1566HA hydro-cooled)

connects_to.relationship: Bitcoin mining rigs supplied to Cipher's joint-venture mining sites

contracts.signal: CEO Tyler Page: Cipher's 49% interests in its three 40 megawatt joint venture sites (Alborz, Bear and Chief) were acquired in an all-stock transaction by Canaan, which he called 'a highly reputable manufacturer of industry-leading Bitcoin miners'; given 'Canaan's role as the supplier of mining rigs to the JV sites', Canaan was 'the most natural buyer', and he said Canaan 'has consistently delivered the best performing rigs in our fleet'. He said vertical integration of rig manufacturer and site operator is the way of the future in Bitcoin mining.
contracts.type: supply relationship (stated by the customer's CEO)
